headline: Petitions for entertainment, festival, and alcohol licenses, including a Dragon Boat Festival and Guatemalan Festival 2026.
summary: The meeting covers license petitions for festivals, including the Matanca Porco at 682 Roosevelt Avenue and the Guatemalan Festival 2026 at 354 Pine Street. It also covers new and renewed licenses for a public laundry, sign boards, a victualling house, and waste haulers.
items: Petition by Blackstone Valley Tourism Council for an entertainment license for a Dragon Boat Festival at Festival Pier, Tim Healey Way, on Saturday, September 5, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. until 3:30 p.m. (LIC#EVT-26-73, Pawtucket Arts Festival)
New public laundry license: So Fresh & Clean Laundry (Handley Pawtucket LLC), 50 Ann Mary Street, LIC#LAU-26-3
Sign board renewal: New England Gold and Silver (New England Gold and Silver LLC), 1571 Newport Ave. (1), LIC#SGN24-4
Sign board renewal: Off the Hook (Baptista, Richard), 269 Main St. (1), LIC#SGN-24-2
New first class victualling house license: CITGO (OM Shree Aria Corp), 42 Dexter St., VIC-26-17
Waste hauler renewal: Goulin Trucking Co (Goulin Trucking Company Inc.), 28 Graham Avenue, Warwick, RI, (1), LIC#WST24-13
Waste hauler renewal: Ocean State Disposal (Ocean State Disposal Inc.), 23 City View Circle, North Providence, RI, (2), LIC#WST-24-9

Petition by Latinos Unidos de Rhode Island for an entertainment and Class F-1 (Full Privilege) license for a Guatemalan Festival 2026, with alcohol sales, at 354 Pine Street (parking lot), on Saturday, September 12, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m. (rain date 9/13/2026, from 10:00 a.m. until 9:00 p.m.), LIC#EVT-26-70

Petition by Zona 7 for an entertainment license and one-day expansion of premises for a Matanca Porco (Pig Festival), indoors and outdoors, at 682 Roosevelt Avenue (parking lot), on Saturday, August 29, 2026, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. until 10:00 p.m., with food and alcohol service, LIC#EVT-26-74. Previous stipulations: no glass used outside, only plastic; outside cleaned up by 10:00 a.m. the next day.
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 2nd Floor – Temporary Council Chambers (enter parking lot at 75 Sabin Street); shown live online
